title: Nvidia’s Nemotron 3.5 Just Launched, But A Bigger 1 Trillion Parameter Model Is Reportedly Already In The Works
key_facts: Nvidia released Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a model of around 30 billion parameters designed to run AI agents efficiently (Stocktwits says 'on Tuesday').
The Information reports Nvidia is developing Nemotron 4, expected to exceed 1 trillion parameters, roughly twice the size of the current largest Nemotron, Nemotron 3 Ultra, released in June.
Nvidia has not set a release date for Nemotron 4; two people familiar with the project said it could arrive as soon as this fall.

Nvidia says Nemotron 3.5 Lightning can deliver up to four times faster output and complete agentic tasks 30% faster than comparable models, and lets companies customise it with their own data, tools and workflows; Nvidia also released free model-routing software.
A larger Nvidia model could compete with customers such as OpenAI, Microsoft and SpaceX, some of which are developing their own AI chips.
Nvidia has put $30 billion into OpenAI, has backed Reflection AI and Thinking Machines Lab, and organised a 'Nemotron Coalition' with Mistral, Cursor, Cognition and Prime Intellect.

The Information says more than 570 authors contributed to Nvidia's latest major model paper and that Nvidia's cloud-compute budget for Nemotron development is capped at $7 billion through fiscal 2028.
quote_evidence: Nvidia (NVDA) on Tuesday released its Nemotron 3.5 Lightning AI model while reportedly developing a much larger Nemotron 4 model that could put the chipmaker in more direct competition with some of its biggest customers.
The Information’s report said Nvidia has not set a release date for Nemotron 4 yet, though two people familiar with the project said it could arrive as soon as this fall.
Nvidia's Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is a smaller model designed to run AI agents efficiently.
why_it_matters_hint: Nvidia is moving from selling chips to building large open models, which could make it a rival to some of its own customers.
event_date: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning released Tuesday 11 Aug 2026 (Google News listings of Nvidia's blog, CNBC, Reuters and The Information are dated 11 Aug 2026; Stocktwits says only 'on Tuesday'); Stocktwits article listed 11 Oct 2026.
notes: OLDER NEWS RE-DATED. Stocktwits says 'on Tuesday' without a date, but the release and The Information's Nemotron 4 report both date from 11 Aug 2026 (Reuters, CNBC, Seeking Alpha and others carried them that day; shattered.io says the story 'resurfaced' this week). Read Stocktwits in full; Nemotron 4 rests on The Information and two unnamed people, Nvidia has not confirmed it. Suggest the editor holds it as stale_redated.
